## 9. 进阶用法

- **添加注释** `addComment(id: string, comment: any, position: number, coverage: boolean)`
- **添加错误提示** `addErrorPrompt(message: string)`
- **重写内置积木执行方法**：
  ```javascript
  // 重写内置 随机数block的执行方法
  operator_random(generator, block, parameter) {
      let code = `random(${parameter.FROM.code}, ${parameter.TO.code}+1)`;
      generator.addSetup(`dfrobotRandomSeed`, `dfrobotRandomSeed();`, 9);
      return ([code, generator.ORDER_UNARY_POSTFIX]);
  }
  ```
